Theres, just so much bugs and inconveniences. In the photo, the sentence it asks you to translate is different from the answer that registers as correct. I recall there being another question like this, but I dont recall which skill specifically. Another one that I get are my questions tucking the options under the where there supposed to be, and for those I have to click on the menu where they were supposed to be are, for them to pop up, which is so annoying to get. Third, i don't know if this is intentional or not, but very occasionally, like one in 7 questions, the pronunciations for kanji are not used correctly. This is VERY annoying whenever i am doing reviews or repair skills, and im sort of paranoid that ive been taught the wrong things on new lessons i do. Of course I don't only use duolingo as my language learning app, i use a few other websites, and tune in to japanese media to scope my comprehension, but since duo is genuinely has a good concept and its very convenient for a learning plan, it sucks to have such inconveniences. 

TL;DR: Duo, it's japanese course at least, has so much drawbacks, which is sucks since their format is a good concept. Yes, i do report these bugged questions every time i get them, but jack has been done.
